notes.title: Patch Notes 0.6.2.3: Talent Tree Unlocked!
notes.content:
[h3]A Word from the Dev[/h3]  
Hey friends ( *︾▽︾) long time no see! Over the past two months, I’ve been closely following and updating [i]Neon Ascending[/i], and I’m confident this round of content will be even more satisfying for everyone~

As for the most anticipated feature — we’ve finished the first version of the Talent Tree! It currently includes 93 nodes covering multiple aspects like economy, offense, defense, and multi-turret strategies. We’ll continue expanding the depth of these paths in the future.

On the performance side, we've improved the frame rate by at least 20%, maybe even 30%? Anyway, it's a lot smoother now!

What’s next on the roadmap? Something like this:
[olist]
[*]Expand the Talent Tree with additional and unique nodes  
[*]Add new affixes, equipment modules, and enemies  
[*]Alien fusion — or perhaps a brand new experimental mode  
[/olist]

Thanks so much for playing and supporting the game!  
If you enjoy it, please share your screenshots and videos — help us get the word out!

[h3]Update Details[/h3]  
[olist]  
[*][b][New Content][/b] Talent Tree is here! Now you can guarantee getting Prisms, Synthesizers, or Weapons under certain conditions; enhance damage and effects; or pick some quirky off-meta bonuses!  
[*][b][BUG][/b] Fixed an issue where lightning effects appeared excessively bright under some conditions  
[*][b][BUG][/b] Fixed several translation issues
[*][b][Balance][/b] Ice Breaking no longer grants crit rate — now it and Fragile together determine extra damage and trigger frequency
[*][b][Balance][/b] Bouncing projectiles now last longer and are less likely to disappear
[*][b][Balance][/b] Avalanche projectiles now inherit more stats, and generate more shots when more freezing effects are active
[*][b][Balance][/b] Power Ball are now affected by Massive — meaning they become much larger  
[*][b][Optimization][/b] Improved frame rate when many projectiles and enemies are on screen
[*][b][Optimization][/b] Taking damage while speeding up the game no longer resets game speed — pace yourself!
[/olist]

notes.title: Version Update 0.5.2.0
notes.content:
1. [b]Content Update[/b]
    - A new module called “Magic Hat” has been introduced. It enhances other enhancement modules in an unstable manner

2. [b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
    - Reduced the early-game offensive pressure from enemies (mobs) to provide a smoother gameplay experience
    - Improved the Retriever's search capabilities, making its logic more consistent and aligned with player expectations

3. [b]Feature Enhancements[/b]
    - Added support for using the right mouse button instead of the middle mouse button to move the camera and rotate modules.
    - At the start of the game, players can now re-roll their weapon choices an unlimited number of times

4. [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
    - Fixed the issue where clicking to skip while picking up a module would cause the game to freeze
